title: Characterizations of continuous adequate objective functions for ordinal or interval scaled data
abstract: arXiv:2608.20074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective functions (goodness criteria which have to be optimized) that are considered, for instance, in cluster analysis, factor analysis, (linear) structural equation modeling, (linear) regression, multidimensional scaling, choice theory, and utility theory, must be {\em adequate}, i.e. carefully adapted to the structure of the observed data. Adequateness of an objective function means, in our terminology, that (certain) transformations of its arguments, e.g. changes in the unit measures of the quantities involved, do not influence the solutions of the optimization procedure. In this paper we concentrate our attention on affine strictly increasing transformations and we also incorporate the case of continuous adequate objective functions accordingly. The characterization of adequate dissimilarity coefficients for interval scaled data shows the appropriateness of the concept of adequateness that is developed in this paper.

translated_title: 有序或区间尺度数据下连续适当目标函数的刻画
translated_abstract: 在聚类分析、因子分析、（线性）结构方程建模、（线性）回归、多维尺度分析、选择理论和效用理论等领域中，所考虑的目标函数（需优化的优良性准则）必须是“适当的”，即需仔细适应观测数据的结构。在我们的术语中，目标函数的适当性意味着其参数的（某些）变换，例如所涉及量的单位度量变化，不会影响优化过程的结果。本文重点关注仿射严格递增变换，并相应地纳入连续适当目标函数的情形。对区间尺度数据下适当相异系数的刻画，展示了本文所发展适当性概念的适用性。
tldr: 本文刻画了连续适当目标函数的特征，证明其不受仿射严格递增变换的影响，并通过区间尺度数据的相异系数示例验证了该概念的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes continuous adequate objective functions, showing they are invariant under affine strictly increasing transformations, and validates the concept via dissimilarity coefficients for interval-scaled data.
